image_description: Two cloth diapers (reusable nappies) placed side-by-side on a textured, brownish-yellow patterned surface (likely a rug or blanket). The left diaper is light blue/teal with white polka dots and visible snap buttons. The right diaper is a slightly darker blue with similar white snaps and elasticized leg openings. Both show the characteristic bulky, padded shape of infant diapers.

The curvature of the waistband on the right diaper seems slightly inconsistent with the rest of the object's perspective, appearing somewhat flattened.
